language_task: Put the spoon in the drawer.
outcome_evidence: The robot grasps the wooden spoon and lifts it from the table in frames 70–90 (image, left_ego_image, wrist_image), then carries it toward the open drawer in frames 100–152. In frames 153–157, wrist_image shows the spoon released into the drawer and the empty fingers withdrawing; image shows the spoon remaining inside the drawer through frame 170. No failed acquisition or unintended side effect is visible.
